questions.prompt: Graph y = (x + 3)² − 2. Drag the vertex first, then drag a second point on the graph.
solutionSteps: The vertex is (h, k) = (-3, -2).
Move 1 unit right: y changes by 1, landing on (-2, -1).
a = 1, so the graph is not reflected.
